{{Quote|Five-Seven, are you receiving?''"<br />"''With you in ten, sir. Stand by.|Null-5 to Five-Seven, as the former awaits extraction from Olanet|<ref name="Odds">{{InsiderCite|87|Odds}}</ref>}}
'''Five-Seven''' was the callsign of a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] assigned to [[Traffic Interdiction Vessel]] [[TIV Z766/2]], in which he was ordered to retrieve [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|ARC Trooper]] [[Prudii Skirata|Null-5]] and [[clone commando]] [[Atin Skirata|RC-3222]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Olanet]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. He was involved in a brief but intense [[Space warfare/Legends|confrontation]] in the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] while in [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] space a [[Standard day/Legends|day]] later, which resulted in a Neimoidian [[Transport/Legends|transport's]] destruction. After the skirmish, Five-Seven and his passengers rendezvoused on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] planet [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] with [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Kal Skirata]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You Null boys are my favorite fares, never a dull moment|Five-Seven to Null-5|<ref name="Odds" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Five-Seven piloted [[Traffic Interdiction Vessel]] [[TIV Z766/2]]<ref name="Odds" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] while serving with the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]]. 460 [[Standard day/Legends|days]]<ref name="Dates">''[[Odds]]'' states that the events detailed in this article occurred over the span of three successive days, beginning 460 days after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. Based on ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' stating that the First Battle of Geonosis occurred in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]], which states that a [[Standard year/Legends|standard year]] occurs every 368 [[Standard day/Legends|days]], the events involving Five-Seven must have occurred in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], specifically 460-462 days after the First Battle of Geonosis.</ref> after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], Five-Seven was assigned to exfiltrate [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|ARC trooper]] [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Prudii Skirata|Null-5]] "Prudii" and [[clone commando]] [[Atin Skirata|RC-3222]] "Atin"<ref name="Odds" /> from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Olanet]] in his heavily-camouflaged TIV freighter. The two special forces operatives had been sabotaging the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Olanet droid factory|factory]] on Olanet, and were successfully retrieved by Five-Seven.<ref name="Odds" />

A day later,<ref name="Dates" /> Five-Seven was ordered by Prudii to enter [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] space on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|Super-hyperroute]], which was concerning to Atin, but the Prudii and Five-Seven remained unworried even in intensely hostile territory. Affirming Atin's concerns, a Confederacy [[Transport/Legends|transport]] laden with an estimated thousand battle droids neared the jump point alongside the TIV. At Prudii's command, however, Five-Seven launched a spread of six [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]], which summarily destroyed the transport&mdash;and it's contents&mdash;as Five-Seven made the jump into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] for safer territory.<ref name="Odds" />

After the close call in the Hydian Way, Five-Seven piloted the TIV to the rendezvous point<ref name="Odds" /> on the temperate [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] planet<ref name="Drall">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref> [[Drall (planet)|Drall]], where Prudii and Atin debriefed with their mentor and adopted father, [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Kal Skirata]],<ref name="Odds" /> a day after the Hydian Way confrontation.<ref name="Dates" /> Following a short exchange with Skirata, Atin returned to the TIV and Five-Seven, ready to return<ref name="Odds" /> to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] planet of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> headquarters of Atin's [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|home unit]].<ref name="Odds" />

==Personality and traits==
As a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Five-Seven stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and was born<ref name="SWE" /> on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] world<ref name="EA" /> of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="SWE" /> Five-Seven enjoyed operating with the Null-class ARC troopers and was calm and professional at the helm of his TIV, even while performing precise combat actions.<ref name="Odds" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Ready torpedoes.''"<br />"''Torps ready.''"<br />"''Steady... on my mark... ''take take take''"''<br />"''Torps away.|Null-5 and Five-Seven, working in sync to destroy a Confederacy transport trailing Five-Seven's freighter|<ref name="Odds" />}}
Five-Seven expertly piloted his Traffic Intervention Vessel in combat, and was able to, with the assistance of Prudii, destroy an enemy transport ship with enough precision to leap into hyperspace at the moment of the transport's destruction, saving the TIV from damage while simultaneously exiting hostile space.<ref name="Odds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Five-Seven first appeared in the short story ''[[Odds]]'' by [[Karen Traviss]], which was featured in [[Star Wars Insider 87|''Star Wars Insider'' 87]] in [[April]] [[2006]]. An illustration of Five-Seven by [[Robert Hendrickson]] was featured with the story,<ref name="Odds" /> which strongly reflected the image of a [[:File:Clone trooper pilot.jpg|clone trooper pilot]] that appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars:'' Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="EpII">{{Film|II}}</ref>
